el.Hace más de diez años acompaño a alumnas: For more than ten years I have been guiding students and Yoga teachers to deepen their practice and find their own way of teaching.
el.Todas las propuestas de Piku Yoga parten: Every Piku Yoga program grows from a holistic view of Yoga, understanding the practice as a path that runs through body, mind and spirit.
el.Dirijo el Instructorado y el Posgrado en: I lead the Teacher Training and the Postgraduate program in Yoga Esencial, hold an ongoing study group, teach weekly Hatha Yoga classes, support projects through one-on-one mentoring, and bring Yoga practices to retreats and experiences.

el.Devoluciones de alumnas y alumnos de las: Feedback from students of Piku Yoga's trainings.
el.Piku Yoga es el espacio de formación y p: Piku Yoga is the Yoga training and practice space of Piku Montiel, a Yoga teacher with more than ten years of experience. Everything is taught online, live on Zoom and with recorded classes, from any country.
el.La formación anual es Yoga Esencial. Se: The annual training is Yoga Esencial. It takes place in two stages: the Teacher Training, from March to August, and the Postgraduate program, from September to November. You can take them together or separately.
el.¿Hace falta formación previa para empeza: Do I need previous training to start?
el.No. El Instructorado en Yoga Esencial es: No. The Yoga Esencial Teacher Training is designed for starting from scratch. The Postgraduate program is for those who have already trained or already teach.
el.¿Las clases son en vivo o grabadas?: Are the classes live or recorded?
They are live on Zoom and they're recorded. If you can't make it at that time, you can watch the recording whenever suits you and still follow the course.
el.¿Desde qué países se puede cursar?: Which countries can I join from?
el.Desde cualquiera. Las clases son online: Any of them. Classes are online and in Spanish, and schedules are set in Argentina time.
el.Escribiendo por WhatsApp. Ahí Piku te cu: Just message me on WhatsApp. There Piku will explain the payment options and reserve your spot.
el.¿No sabés cuál te sirve?: Not sure which one is right for you?
el.Contame en qué estás y en qué momento de: Tell me what you're looking for and where you are in your practice, and together we'll find your next step.
